title: boechera perennans subsp. texana
intro: Boechera perennans subsp. texana, commonly known as Texas rockcress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat inflammation, pain, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Boechera perennans subsp. texana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include isothiocyanates, glucosinolates, and other compounds that have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
